interpretation: Primary: E3 crisis F1 (argmax -> code >= 2) on origin-known keys per H, known - original and each - persistence on the same keys; crisis-call share, macro-F1, unweighted Brier and log loss alongside. FIT-known is in-sample, C-known in-window interpolation. Missing-origin E3 rows are counted only (no scores, no extrapolation) and nothing is compared with all-key scores. The restriction changes sample size, calendar regime, era, composition, missingness selection and optimisation path together; no causal or covariate-shift claim. AUC/AP within-root, mean-fold only. 21 overlapping, repeatedly developed folds: no significance test, no adoption rule.
